entities.summary:
Stephen of Armenia was the marshal of Armenia, the son of Leo I, Prince of Armenia and Beatrice of Rethel.

As a member of the royal family of Armenia, Stephen of Armenia played a crucial role in the politics of the region during the 12th century. His birth and death dates are not well-documented, but his significance lies in his involvement in the medieval history of Armenia.

Stephen of Armenia's legacy is tied to the tumultuous period of the Armenian kingdom, which was marked by power struggles and conflicts with neighboring kingdoms. His death in 1165 marked the end of an era, and his successor, Prince Levon I, would go on to shape the future of Armenia.

The passage of time has left behind a lasting cultural footprint in the form of Armenian literature and art, which continues to celebrate the heritage of the Armenian people.
